fixes.what: tang-dynasty_705 (705-749) is verdict ok and its note says 'The Beiting protectorate north of the Tianshan is inside the shape', but the shape lacks Beiting, the Turpan basin, Hami, Suyab and Liaodong, all of which the ledger holds as Tang in those years.
fixes.why: shapes.csv bbox 73.08,17.77,122.71,42.76 (max lat 42.76 N; Beshbalik/Beiting is at 44.08 N, Gaochang 42.85 N, Turpan 42.94 N, Liaoyang 123.18 E). Cell test (tools/grid.py polity_cells, year 720): Turpan, Gaochang, Beshbalik, Hami, Liaoyang all absent. Ledger: Turfan gained 640 (/ledger/19), Dzungaria 657 (/ledger/25), lost only in 790 (/ledger/63); Goguryeo land gained 668 (/ledger/29), never lost. Anxi page: 'In 702 Wu Zetian set up the Beiting Protectorate in Ting Prefecture'.
fixes.fix: Verdict adjust; correction = union of Cliopatria Tang 705 with Turfan-Hami and Dzungaria (Beiting) and with whatever Manchurian land the ledger still holds; delete the false sentence from the note; add the ledger losses that explain the eastern retreat (see /ledger/29).

fixes.what: tang-dynasty_674 (674-681) correction removes only Baekje, but the shape also lacks the Tarim, the Turpan basin, Hami and Beiting while the ledger has the Tang holding the Tarim 673-677 and 679-687 and Turfan-Hami throughout.
fixes.why: Cell diff 673->674: 5460 cells removed, median 41.2 N 84.1 E (Tarim, Dzungaria, Semirechye). Cell test at 678: Kuqa, Hotan, Turpan, Gaochang, Beshbalik, Hami absent. Ledger /ledger/33 673 gain Tarim, /ledger/37 679 gain Tarim; Anxi page: 'The Tang also captured Qiuci and established control over the Western Regions in the same year' (673) and 'In 679 the Tang general, Pei Xingjian, defeated Ashina Duzhi as well as the Tibetans'.
fixes.fix: Correction = (Cliopatria Tang 674 minus Baekje) plus Turfan-Hami and the Beiting/Tingzhou area for the whole span, plus the Tarim Basin for 674-676 and 679-681 (or split the keyframe at 677 and 679).

fixes.what: tang-dynasty_682 (682-691) is verdict ok, but the shape lacks the Tarim (the ledger holds it until the 686 withdrawal/687 loss) and the Turpan basin, Hami and Beiting (held throughout), and drops Pyongyang with no ledger event.
fixes.why: Cell test at 685: Kuqa, Hotan, Turpan, Gaochang, Beshbalik, Hami, Pyongyang absent, Liaoyang present. Anxi page: 'In 686 Tang troops withdrew from the Four Garrisons'; 'In 687 the Tibetan Empire established control over the Western Regions' (/ledger/39).
fixes.fix: Verdict adjust; correction adds the Tarim Basin for 682-686 and Turfan-Hami and Beiting for the span; either add Pyongyang back or add a dated loss of northern Korea.

fixes.what: tang-dynasty_692 (692-704) is verdict ok but lacks the Turpan basin, Hami and Beiting, which the ledger holds as Tang.

fixes.fix: Verdict adjust; correction = Cliopatria Tang 692 plus Turfan-Hami and (from 702 at least) the Beiting area.

fixes.what: The 668 gain of Goguryeo's land (Manchuria and northern Korea) is never undone: the ledger has no loss of Pyongyang, Liaodong or Manchuria, so the map keeps them Tang to 907 while Balhae is founded there in 698.
fixes.why: Cliopatria drops Pyongyang in the 682 shape and Liaodong in the 705 shape (cell diff 704->705: 1265 cells, about 320,000 km2, median 41.0 N 125.5 E); both keyframes are verdict ok with no event. Silla-Tang War page: 'The Tang were forced to relocate the seat of the Protectorate General to Pacify the East to ... Liaoyang' (676), then Xincheng (677), and 'Later, most of the land north of the Taedong River went to Balhae' (no year). balhae.json /ledger/0: 698 found, counterpart nobody. The 676 loss (/ledger/35) says the Tang kept the land north of the Taedong.
fixes.fix: Add the losses with a page that dates them (Protectorate General to Pacify the East; Balhae): northern Korea around Pyongyang (c. 676-682) and Manchuria/Liaodong (c. 698-705, counterpart balhae or nobody), and make keyframes 682 and 705 consistent with them. Also say in the 666 keyframe correction that Goguryeo's land enters from 668 (Cliopatria adds it only in 674).

fixes.what: The 657 gain of Semirechye is never undone, and no Cliopatria Tang shape contains Suyab, so the corrections from 757 on drop Semirechye with no event.

fixes.fix: Add a loss of Semirechye (Suyab) to turgesh, dated from the Anxi page (719, or 703 if a page gives it), and decide whether the 674-691 shapes need Suyab added (seat 670-, garrison 679-719).

fixes.what: tang-dynasty_830 (830-849) is verdict ok, but the shape has lost Chengdu and western Sichuan (about 205,000 km2) while the note itself says Nanzhao 'withdrew the following year'; the 850 correction (/keyframe_review/24) also leaves Sichuan out.

fixes.fix: 830: verdict adjust, correction = union(Cliopatria Tang 830, Cliopatria Tang 829 within the Sichuan Basin); 850: add the same Sichuan land to its union. No ledger event is needed if no land changed hands.

fixes.fix: Widen /ledger/7 to the xiao-xian-s-liang dissolve land, add Zhejiang to /ledger/8 (or a second gain), and make the 623 correction the union of the 621-622 gains (or the 626 shape minus Fu Gongshi's Song until 624).

Shape membership was tested with tools/grid.py polity_cells (local Cliopatria cell cache) at sample years and named places; numbers in the findings are cell counts at H3 resolution 5 (about 250 km2 per cell).

The Manchuria, Semirechye, Turfan-Hami/Beiting and Sichuan-830 faults are inherited from the Phase A example polities/_example-tang-dynasty.json, which has the same ledger and keyframe verdicts for those years; the example should not be used as a reference for them.
